notes.title: VED | Patch v1.0.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been able to fix several issues you've reported with VED, and incorporate small, but noticeable improvements as well - therefore we have just released an update with the following changes:


 Added separate sliders for selecting subtitle and voiceover language in settings.
 Fixed bugs that could cause unnecessary delays during dialogues in Chapter 1.
 Improved the wording of some choices in Chapter 2.
 Added a GENERAL HEALTH WARNING disclaimer before the game launches.


If you have any feedback, criticism, or suggestions on what we can improve, you are most welcome to join the Karaclan Discord server, we will happily answer your questions and do our best to help with any issue you might have, including fixing potential bugs. And if you are enjoying the game already, we will be extremely grateful for a positive review here on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/

notes.title: VED Release Date Announced - November 14, 2024!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36178181/c3d17a529fc226fc86aefcf96040452523c74af9.jpg

Hello everyone!

We have wonderful news today, your journey between the human and the magical world becomes in two short weeks - VED launches on all platforms on November 14, 2024!

Let's take a look at a new trailer we have prepared for this joyous occasion:

[previewyoutube=ooVLL_YHOC8;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to see how you enjoy the story, what choices you will make and what fate you will decide for the two worlds - for now, we cordially invite you to try out the free demo we have available. It's just a small sample of the narrative experience coming in two weeks, nevertheless, we would love to hear what you think, so please, tell us either here in the comments, in the Steam Discussions, or come chat with us on the Karaclan Discord server!

And more surprises are coming before the release - make sure you wishlist and follow the game here on Steam so you don't miss anything!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/

notes.title: DEMO version of VED is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have great news for you! You can now play a demo version of VED here on Steam for free! It will be available at least until August 15 but there's nothing to wait for, download and play the demo right now!

We will be very grateful for any feedback you can provide, so feel free to join our Discord server or start a discussion here on Steam!

Enjoy the game, let us know how you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/
